title: Game speed
summary: Fast forward on the map and the battle speed limit.

sections.heading: On the Dashboard
steps: The Game speed part of the Game time card says if 2x speed and the battle speed limit are on.
Turn on 2x speed lets the host and players fast forward on the campaign map.
Turn on battle speed limit puts time back to normal speed while any player is in a battle.
Players change the speed with the time buttons at the bottom of the map, or the keys 1, 2 and 3.

sections.heading: On the Settings page
steps: The same choices are in the Game speed group at the top of Settings.
2x speed needs Fast forwarding set to True and Allow clients to control campaign time ticked.
Speed limit while players are in battle keeps time at 1x while any player fights.
Press Save settings to keep a change.

sections.heading: When it takes effect
steps: The buttons on the Dashboard save right away.
A running server keeps its old speed until it restarts. Click Restart server on the card.
sections.tip: If 2x speed is on but nobody can speed up, check that Allow clients to control campaign time is ticked.
